plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Read at your own pace
plans.notFoundHint: This plan is no longer available.
plans.needsContent: The translation text is needed before a plan can be built.
plans.revelation365Desc: Read the Qur'an in the order it was revealed, over a year. About seventeen verses a day; you follow how the revelation unfolded.
plans.revelation180Desc: The same chronological flow at a brisker pace. About thirty-five verses a day.
plans.mushaf30Desc: The Mushaf order in a month. The classic pace, meant for Ramadan; one juz a day.
plans.mushaf90Desc: The Mushaf order, unhurried. About seventy verses a day.
plans.restartMessage: The plan restarts from today. Days you have completed are kept; only the accumulated delay is cleared.
plans.streakEmpty: Complete your first day to start a streak
plans.streakToday: Read today to keep the streak going

settings.title: Settings
settings.previewText: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire
settings.showArabicHint: Show the original above the translation
settings.sortByRevelationHint: When off, the Mushaf order is used
settings.resetReadingHint: Text size, line spacing and display preferences
settings.resetConfirmBody: Text size, line spacing and display preferences return to their defaults. Your notes and bookmarks aren't affected.
settings.notificationDenied: Notification permission was not granted. You can enable it in Settings > Notifications.
settings.dailyAyahBody: Today's verse is waiting for you.

tour.replayHint: Replays the introduction tips on the home and reading screens.

home.verseOfDayBody: A different verse greets you every time you open the app. Tap it to jump to its place in the surah.
home.lastReadTitle: Pick up where you left off
home.lastReadBody: The last verse you read is remembered. This card reopens it with a single tap.
home.orderBody: Surahs are listed either by revelation order or mushaf order. This button switches between them.

reader.longPressBody: Long-pressing a verse opens bookmarking, notes, colour highlighting, sharing and root analysis.
reader.settingsTitle: Set the text to your liking
reader.settingsBody: Font size, line spacing and Arabic visibility are set here. Changes apply instantly.
reader.endCardBody: Keep scrolling at the end of a surah, or tap the card; the next surah opens without going back to the list.

search.fieldBody: Just type a word; every verse where it appears in the translation or commentary is listed.
search.turkishBody: Typing "adalet" also finds "adâlet". Case and accented letters won't break the search.

plans.cardBody: Each plan splits the Qur'an into daily portions over a set period. Tap a card to see the days.
plans.orderBody: "Revelation order" follows the order verses were revealed; "Mushaf" follows the familiar surah order.
plans.progressBody: Completed days are marked. Even after a break, you continue where you left off.

roots.rootBody: Arabic words derive from three-letter roots. This is the root of the word you tapped.
roots.occurrencesBody: All verses containing words from this root. The highlight shows the derived form in that verse.
roots.searchBody: Search roots by their letters here, and compare roots with related meanings.
